projects.title: Kamugram
projects.subtitle: Swahili search engine & Telegram bot
projects.summary: A three-tier fallthrough search pipeline over 16,000+ Swahili entries: local FTS5 index, live web sources, then Gemini as a last resort.
highlights: Fallthrough pipeline checks local SQLite indexes first, queries live web sources second, and falls back to Gemini for missing definitions.
Cut query response times by 80% with an asynchronous Redis caching layer (aiohttp).
Containerised with Podman Compose to manage async task queues and persistent volumes.

projects.title: Forum
projects.subtitle: High-concurrency discussion platform
projects.summary: A Go web forum built with idiomatic concurrency patterns, supporting 100+ concurrent users on a SQLite backend.
highlights: Idiomatic Go concurrency for request handling and sessions.
SQLite persistence, Dockerised for reproducible deploys.
Reviewed and shipped under GitHub Flow.

projects.title: VoltPass
projects.subtitle: Telegram credential manager
projects.summary: An async HTTPS webhook service processing real-time Telegram payloads, with a strictly isolated MongoDB CRUD engine.
highlights: Asynchronous HTTPS webhook architecture for real-time POST payloads from the Telegram API.
MongoDB CRUD engine with strict per-user data isolation and single-click payload copying.
Administrative telemetry dashboards.

projects.title: Net-Cat
projects.subtitle: TCP group chat utility
projects.summary: A netcat-style TCP chat server in Go handling up to 10 simultaneous connections with raw socket programming.
highlights: Raw TCP sockets and goroutine-per-connection design.
Broadcast fan-out with safe shared state.

projects.title: Max-Flow Router
projects.subtitle: Graph routing with Edmonds-Karp
projects.summary: Routes agents through a network with minimal turns using Edmonds-Karp maximum flow, backtracking and DFS.
highlights: Edmonds-Karp maximum flow for path capacity.
Backtracking and DFS for optimal path selection.

projects.title: Dawatrace
projects.subtitle: Pharma provenance on Polygon
projects.summary: Tracks medicine from manufacturer to patient on-chain, with gasless QR verification at the point of sale.
highlights: Solidity contracts on Polygon.
Gasless QR-code verification flow.

projects.title: Agrismart
projects.subtitle: Offline-first farming PWA
projects.summary: A local-first progressive web app that keeps working for farmers with no connectivity and syncs when back online.
highlights: Local-first data model.
Installable, offline-capable PWA.
